description: US carrier call-forwarding codes: activate/deactivate codes for no-answer, busy, and forward-all call forwarding, plus portal paths for carriers without self-serve dial codes.

placeholders.NUMBER11: 11-digit destination number starting with 1, digits only

verified_note: Each entry names its source; most are the carrier's own published support documentation. Last full review: 2026-10-03.

carriers.name: Verizon (wireless)
carriers.notes: Forwarding can only be managed from the phone itself, not the Verizon app or website.

carriers.name: AT&T (wireless)
carriers.notes: **004* forwards the calls you don't answer, decline (declined calls count as busy on GSM), or miss with no signal, in one code; *61* covers no-answer only. Dial the code like a phone number and press call. If the handset rejects them, use the phone's call-forwarding settings menu (Android: Phone app > Settings > Calling accounts > SIM > Call forwarding) or call 611. Cricket, Consumer Cellular, H2O and Red Pocket run on AT&T's network and take the same codes.

carriers.name: T-Mobile
carriers.notes: **004* forwards no answer, busy/declined and unreachable calls in one code; ##004# resets all forwarding rules. If the phone says it cannot process the request, turn off Wi-Fi calling and dial again. Metro, Mint, Boost, Ultra Mobile, Google Fi, US Mobile, Tello and Simple Mobile run on T-Mobile's network and take the same codes.

carriers.name: Verizon landline (copper POTS)
carriers.notes: On most Verizon landlines the forward-to number is provisioned by the Verizon business office; if the code does not take, the carrier sets the destination number.

carriers.name: Verizon Fios Digital Voice
carriers.portal_path: My Verizon > Account Manager > Calling Features
carriers.notes: Managed online, not via dial codes. Features: Call Forwarding (all calls), Simultaneous Ring (rings a second number alongside), Locate Me (rings phones in order).

carriers.name: AT&T landline (traditional)
carriers.forward_all_activate: *72 then enter the 10-digit number; stays pending until the forwarded-to line answers once
carriers.ring_time_code: *47, then at the second dial tone 18 for three rings or 24 for four
carriers.notes: No-answer forwarding on traditional AT&T lines is enabled by an agent (800.288.2020).

carriers.name: Xfinity Voice (Comcast)
carriers.portal_path: xfinity.com or Xfinity app > Xfinity Voice settings > Call Forwarding
carriers.notes: No busy or no-answer dial codes. Advanced Call Forwarding (portal only) can ring a second number alongside the line and set rings-before-voicemail. Comcast Business lines differ: see comcast-business.

carriers.name: Blue Ridge Communications
carriers.portal_path: My Blue Ridge app/website > phone line > Edit > Call Handling > Forward All
carriers.notes: Documents ONLY forward-all. There is no *73 and no busy or no-answer variant.

carriers.name: Spectrum (home phone)
carriers.portal_path: spectrum.net > Voice > Call Forwarding (No Answer forwarding is portal-only)
carriers.notes: Spectrum Business lines differ: see spectrum-business (no-answer forwarding by dial code).

carriers.name: Comcast Business Voice and VoiceEdge
carriers.no_answer_activate: *92, then NUMBER10 at the second dial tone (VoiceEdge: at the voice prompt), then wait for the confirmation tone
carriers.portal_path: business.comcast.com > Business Voice: Phone > Features > Call Forwarding (Call Forwarding No Answer); VoiceEdge: Business VoiceEdge User > Feature Settings > Call Forwarding
carriers.notes: Number of rings before forwarding is set online. Comcast says not to turn on Call Forwarding No Answer on a phone in a Hunt Group; a VoiceEdge admin sets the group's No Answer settings instead. Source: Comcast Business support, call forwarding and routing.

carriers.name: Spectrum Business Voice
carriers.no_answer_activate: *92, then NUMBER10, then #, then wait for the confirmation
carriers.portal_path: Spectrum Business account > Voice (Voice Manager) > Call Forwarding > No Answer
carriers.notes: If *92 gives an error tone, No Answer forwarding is not switched on for the line yet; turn it on in the same Call Forwarding settings. Source: Spectrum Business support.

carriers.name: CenturyLink (Lumen) business lines
carriers.no_answer_activate: *92, then NUMBER10 at the dial tone, then wait for the confirmation
carriers.notes: Works only where Call Forwarding No Answer is on the line; CenturyLink adds it on request. Source: answering-service onboarding guides that publish CenturyLink/Lumen steps (Mango Voice, answeringservicecare.com), not a CenturyLink page.

carriers.name: Google Voice
carriers.notes: Google documents that forwarding a Google Voice number to an automated system is unsupported. Supported route: set 'Use carrier only' so calls ring the linked cell through the carrier, turn Screen Calls off, then apply the cell carrier's no-answer forwarding code on the linked phone. Google verifies new linked numbers by a code that must be typed on the called line.

carriers.name: RingCentral
carriers.portal_path: Online account > Settings > Call Handling & Forwarding
carriers.notes: Add a forwarding number and set the number of rings before forwarding.

carriers.name: Vonage
carriers.portal_path: Online account > Features & Settings > Calling Features > Call Forwarding
carriers.notes: Portal path supports ring-seconds-before-forward; handset codes are forward-all only.

carriers.name: Hosted business phone systems (Grasshopper, OpenPhone, Dialpad, Twilio/Bandwidth/Telnyx-based)
carriers.portal_path: Inside the phone system's own app: no-answer or overflow forwarding setting
carriers.notes: Numbers hosted on telephony platforms do not use carrier dial codes; forwarding is an app setting.
